Our story

Built in Salem.
Thinking beyond borders.

சேலத்தில் வேர்கள் · உலகை நோக்கும் பார்வை

inaivu means connection. It reflects how we bring together business understanding, engineering depth and emerging talent to create meaningful technology.

Our journey began through the shared roots of Thiagarajar Polytechnic College alumni. Today, we work with startups and established teams to make ambitious digital initiatives practical, dependable and ready to scale.

in-AI-vu

One name, two ideas. “inaivu” is Tamil for connection. Read as “in-AI-vu,” it also expresses our instinct for being inside AI—seeing it clearly, grasping its possibilities and connecting it to useful outcomes.

Win for clientsSolutions tied to real outcomes.
Win for our teamA culture of ownership and growth.
Win for societyOpportunity and innovation from Salem.
